verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs describe assumptions wired into a connected model. Changing an assumption moves revenue, hiring and cash together (abacum-docs-16), assumptions and scenarios are linked so the plan updates without rebuilding (abacum-docs-6), and headcount planning sits in the same model as the budget (abacum-docs-17). This is the core of driver-based modeling, but the pack never explicitly describes driver-based construction or growth and price-point driver types, and there is no independent confirmation. missing for 10: explicit driver-based modeling documentation, evidence of price-point/unit-price drivers, explicit growth-rate assumption drivers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
